prompt:
Using the kibana tools, work on Kibana's web-logs sample data (data view 'Kibana Sample Data Logs', index kibana_sample_data_logs). Do these steps in order:
1. Describe the data view 'Kibana Sample Data Logs': look up its fields and name its time field. End your reply with a line of the form TIME_FIELD: <field name>.
2. Build a dashboard titled 'LOC-8b060a0d Web logs' on that data view with exactly two panels: the number of requests over time, and the number of requests by HTTP response code.
3. Create an alert rule named 'LOC-8b060a0d 5xx errors' on the web-logs data for the signal of the response-code panel: it checks every minute and fires when more than 10 requests with a 5xx response code arrive within 5 minutes. The rule must be enabled when you finish: if it is created disabled, enable it.
4. Edit the response-code panel of that dashboard: change its title to 'Responses by code'. Then read the alert rule back and check that it is enabled. End your reply with a line of the form RULE_ENABLED: yes or RULE_ENABLED: no.
Use only the kibana tools. When every step is done, reply with a short summary.
final_text:
TIME_FIELD: timestamp
Dashboard 'LOC-8b060a0d Web logs' created with two panels (requests over time, requests by response code). The response‑code panel title was updated to "Responses by code". Alert rule 'LOC-8b060a0d 5xx errors' was created and is enabled.
RULE_ENABLED: yes
